title: Amazon Prime India Review (2026): ₹399 Shopping Edition vs. ₹1,499 Full Plan — Which Pays Back?
description: Prime in India is four plans, not one. The right choice depends on how many sub-₹499 orders you place, whether you stream, and whether you actually use the Amazon Pay ICICI cashback. All figures below were checked on 24 Nov 2026.

forWho: Shoppers placing 5–10 small Amazon orders a year who want free same/one-day delivery and early sale access without paying for streaming.
Households that will actively use Prime Video or Prime Music all year and can justify ₹1,499 over the ₹399 shopping tier.
skipIf: Occasional buyers who batch carts above ₹499 — batching costs ₹0 in shipping, so no plan pays back.
Viewers who only want ad-free streaming: Prime Video ads need a separate ₹699/year add-on, and Prime Lite members must upgrade to Prime first.

content_blocks.body: Pick Prime Shopping Edition at ₹399/year if you mainly want delivery and sale access — it breaks even after about 10 standard-delivery orders or 5 one-day orders a year. Pay ₹1,499 for Full Prime only if you also use Prime Video or Music enough to replace roughly ₹92/month of other streaming spend. The ₹299 monthly plan only wins if you need Prime for a single sale or show window. Confirm current plan names, prices and benefits on the live Amazon.in Prime membership page before subscribing; treat the tier structure reviewed on 24 Nov 2026 as the basis for the break-even math.

ctas.label: Check Live Prime Plans on Amazon India

pros: ₹399 Shopping Edition includes unlimited free same/one-day delivery on eligible items and early sale access, with no streaming bundled in.
Amazon states 5% cashback on Amazon.in with the Amazon Pay ICICI card for eligible Prime members, including Shopping Edition.
Annual ₹1,499 works out to ₹124.92/month versus ₹299 monthly — ₹295 cheaper over six months and ₹2,089 cheaper over twelve.
cons: Prime Shopping Edition has no Prime Video, Prime Music, Prime Reading or Luna — a common checkout misunderstanding.
Prime Video still shows ads; removing them costs a separate ₹699/year add-on on eligible plans.
Same-day delivery is limited to select cities and Prime-eligible items — Amazon calls it a limited-time offer and can change it.

items.q: Does Prime Shopping Edition include Prime Video?
items.a: No. Amazon's help page states that Prime Video, Prime Music, eBooks and Luna are not available with the ₹399 Shopping Edition. You can rent titles or subscribe separately through Prime Video.

items.q: Is Prime Annual cheaper than Prime Monthly?
items.a: Yes if you stay past five months. ₹1,499 ÷ ₹299 = 5.01 months. Six months of monthly billing costs ₹1,794 (₹295 more than annual); twelve months costs ₹3,588 (₹2,089 more).

items.q: How many orders does ₹399 Shopping Edition need to pay back?
items.a: Using Amazon's published non-Prime delivery charges: ₹399 ÷ ₹40 standard ≈ 10 orders a year, ₹399 ÷ ₹79 one-day ≈ 5 orders, or ₹399 ÷ ₹99 same-day ≈ 4 orders. Below that, batching orders above the free-delivery threshold costs nothing.

items.q: Does the ₹399 plan earn 5% Amazon Pay ICICI cashback?
items.a: Amazon's Prime Shopping Edition help page states that eligible Prime members earn 5% cashback on Amazon.in with the Amazon Pay ICICI card, and lists Shopping Edition as a Prime plan. Confirm eligibility on your own checkout page — we have not verified the non-Prime rate.

items.q: How do I remove ads on Prime Video in India?
items.a: Ad-free viewing is a separate ₹699/year add-on on eligible plans. Amazon states that Prime Lite members must upgrade to Prime before they can access Ad-Free. Check primevideo.com/your-account for current eligibility.
